about: A further route for the memory of BioCLIP 2's shipped device file in onnxruntime-web 1.30.0's WASM build: the graph optimized ahead of time by onnxruntime 1.30.0 (Python, CPU, extended level) and saved as ONNX, alone and with its weights in an external data file, run with the worker's options; the shipped file is run on the same machine as the control.
